method: Bounded time-domain energy attacks with linear spectral-flux confirmation; sustained CQT voicings checked with a different STFT representation. Browser output used to withhold unsupported proposals.

adoption.reason: Full-model proposals did not consistently improve output. Sister and I Got a Feeling retain their original performance; Under the Moon retains original voicings. This is a reviewed subset, not an accuracy claim.

initial_trial.method: Same absolute source range, timestamped browser post-master PCM; original other or other+bass+drums. No loudness gain fitted. Normalized pitch-class and power fractions; no time warp or lag fitting.

final_output.method: Same absolute source range, timestamped browser post-master PCM; original other or other+bass+drums. No loudness gain fitted. Normalized pitch-class and power fractions; no time warp or lag fitting.

browser.scope: Desktop Chromium only; no physical iPhone or subjective listening claim

limits: Other includes separation bleed and other instruments. Neither detector nor chord template has human transcription labels.

Post-master captures share an absolute content interval but include run-to-run variation: the two unchanged control scores also show spectral differences. These aggregate numbers cannot certify an improvement or exact note accuracy.

The controlled native adapter renders use exact scheduling, 2 s pre-roll and 3 s crops, post-crunch without global master or room. Final repetitions and unchanged-score controls differ by at most one PCM16 LSB. They do not certify whole-band sound.
Controlled pitch-class distance improves in three sections, increases slightly in two, and is unchanged in the two preserved controls. Chroma cannot validate octave or fret choice.
No new audio, sample, model, dependency or hosting. Original 28 MP3s, bass/drum scores and synthesis bank retained.
Initial contaminated/overlapping test runs were rejected and recaptured; raw trial logs remain local. No subjective fidelity percentage is reported.
reproduce: python -X utf8 scripts/refine-guitar-performance.py --baseline-ref fb60374 --spectrum-cache output/playwright/arcb-band-refinement --out <report.json> (cache is optional; --write refuses already-refined or baseline-ref input)
